_comment: Allow rules live in settings.local.json: a project settings.json's allow rules are ignored until the workspace is trusted, which breaks unattended `claude -p --permission-mode dontAsk` runs. Deny rules and hooks below apply regardless of trust, and deny always beats allow. File rules use Edit(...) not Write(...) - Write rules are not evaluated by file permission checks, while Edit rules cover every file-editing tool.
_comment_onedrive: There is deliberately no blanket Edit(~/OneDrive/**) deny: this bot's own tree lives under OneDrive/Desktop/Agency, so a blanket rule would block it writing its own runs/ and the bot would fail silently every week. The OneDrive protection is instead positive - guard_writes.py permits ONLY runs/ and state/, and guard_commands.py rejects any command path resolving under OneDrive outside this bot. The denies below name the specific sibling trees worth a second lock.
